response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level breadth, deep distributed-systems exposure (high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby), and current hands-on work building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which directly matches the AI-native mindset this role demands. However, the complete absence of Python anywhere in his skills or project history is a significant gap against an explicit must-have, and there's limited resume evidence of formal on-call/incident-response duty or cross-functional stakeholder management at the scale described.
strengths: Currently building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code-generation tooling, directly aligned with agentic-development mindset
Deep low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby using async I/O, fibers, caching)
Broad staff/senior-level career spanning many languages, architectures, and even founding an open-source platform, showing strong systems thinking
concerns: No listed Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have technical skill
No clear evidence of formal on-call rotation, monitoring ownership, or incident response experience
Limited explicit examples of cross-functional stakeholder management with product/leadership at scale
